Sam P.: SI ran into a hard stop during Marketplace install. Cluster egress only via corporate proxy with dynamic NAT. Installer can't reach our registry.
Yara C.: ugh. paste the error?
Sam P.: from the SI engineer: 
```
time="2026-03-20T22:15:02Z" level=error msg="failed to pull image" err="Get \"https://registry.redwood.ai/v2/\": proxyconnect tcp: dial tcp 172.16.8.9:3128: connect: network is unreachable"
```
Leo N.: three practical routes: 1) transient egress via an ephemeral bastion node that has public egress to pull & cache images, 2) signed offline bundle + local registry mirror import, 3) short-lived netops rule to allow our registry CIDRs.
Grace M.: customer is very compliance-first; they prefer the mirror import. But SI asked if we can also provide a small S3-backed registry cache artifact they can bootstrap behind their proxy.
Sam P.: we have signed bundles and an S3 cache flow for air-gapped installs. Link: https://artifacts.redwood.ai/offline-bundles/marketplace/v2.2.0-signed.tar.gz and docs at https://docs.redwood.ai/airgap/cache-flow
Yara C.: SI asked for a minimal, non-technical checklist and a verified manifest for SOC. They also want an example `values.yaml` to point Helm at their mirror.
Leo N.: draft checklist I recommend sending: 
1) Download bundle and signature; verify sha256 and GPG signature.
2) Extract bundle; confirm `manifest.json` digests match.
3) Use `podman load -i <image>.tar` or `ctr -n k8s.io images import <image>.tar` to load images on a bastion or registry-import host.
4) Push to internal registry: `podman tag && podman push`.
5) Update Helm values: `global.imageRegistry: registry.corp.local:5000` and set `imagePullSecrets`.
Example commands: 
```
curl -O <bundle>.tar.gz
sha256sum -c <bundle>.sha256
gpg --verify <bundle>.tar.gz.sig <bundle>.tar.gz
podman load -i edge-agent.tar
podman tag edge-agent:sha256@abc registry.corp.local:5000/redwood/edge-agent:2.2.0
podman push registry.corp.local:5000/redwood/edge-agent:2.2.0
```
Grace M.: include the GPG fingerprint and the signed `manifest.json` so SOC can validate immutability. Fingerprint: 9A3F 4B2D C1E8 77AA 55EE 3F98 1234 5678 9ABC DEF0
integration-bot: marketplace-install job failed for customer-zeta (job id 8123)  automation ticket PART-8042 created
Sam P.: SI also asked if we can provide an ephemeral bastion playbook if the mirror import hits snags. That would be faster for trial installs.
Leo N.: we can offer a lightweight playbook: spin a single EC2 (or VM) with egress, run `docker pull` for required images, push to customer's mirror, then terminate. Add audit steps: list pulled digests, sign the transfer log.
Yara C.: let's also prepare a timeboxed SOC approval template for an ephemeral bastion (e.g., approve for 2 hours, require audit log and image-digest export).
Grace M.: I'll package: signed bundle link, quick checklist, example `values.yaml`, ephemeral bastion playbook, and SOC approval template. We'll mark the bastion flow as "fallback / timeboxed".
Sam P.: SI will try the mirror import first and will request the bastion template only if they hit issues. ETA: they will update in 3 hours. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
